s.note: the Wookiee home world of Kashyyyk
s.how: Slice 500g mixed mushrooms and fry in butter over high heat until golden. Add crushed garlic and thyme and cook another minute. Toast thick slices of sourdough, pile the mushrooms on top and finish with shaved parmesan and a crack of pepper.

Soften a sliced leek in butter, add 300g finely diced chicken breast and cook through. Stir in 150ml cream and chopped tarragon and simmer until thick. Spoon into 16 vol-au-vent cases and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until golden and hot.

m.how: Prick a 2kg duck all over, rub with salt and five-spice and roast at 180C for 1 hour 45 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 oranges, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and 2 star anise until syrupy and brush over for the last 15 minutes. Serve with 300g rice.

w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs and 3 yolks with 80g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 50g flour. Pour into greased moulds and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Turn out and pour over a coulis of blended raspberries.

d.note: baby Luke handed over under the twin suns
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts orange juice and pineapple juice, leaving room at the top. Slowly pour a splash of grenadine down the side so it sinks to the bottom and glows red and orange like a double sunset.
